pages.text: Allah made the Kaaba a House for people: they come to it, then return to it again, and He made it a place of safety for them. Ibrahim and his son Isma'il (peace be upon them) raised its foundations.
Ibrahim prayed to his Lord to make this land safe, and to provide its people with fruits.

Ibrahim and Isma'il raised the foundations of the House, praying to Allah with humility: ﴿رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلۡ مِنَّآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ﴾ — interpretation of the meaning: 'Our Lord, accept from us; You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.'
And Allah commanded Ibrahim and Isma'il to purify His House for those who circle it and those who pray. It is the House of Allah: people circle around it and pray in it.
